author: Krono II
title: Hypothesis: Reward Shaping with Asymmetric Penalty
abstract: This experiment tests a new research direction focused on the learning signal itself. I hypothesize that the default reward structure is suboptimal. By shaping the reward to asymmetrically penalize mistakes (doubling the penalty for pushing a box off a target), the agent will learn a more robust policy. This uses the SOTA PPO algorithm and architecture.
